<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Question, FaqSplitLabels } from "../blocks/faq-split.types";
  import type { FaqTab } from "../blocks/faq-list.types";

  export type FaqFinderProps = {
    items: Question[];
    labels: FaqSplitLabels;
    topics: FaqTab[];
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";

  import SearchField from "../components/search-field.svelte";

  let { items, labels, topics }: FaqFinderProps = $props();
</script>

<Stack gap="6" align="stretch" data-testid="faq-finder">
  <SearchField label={labels.search} placeholder={labels.search} value={(labels.query ?? "")} />
  <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
    {#each topics as t (t.id)}
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="faq-topic" data-value={t.value}>
        {t.title}
      </Button>
    {/each}
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="2">
    <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
      {labels.popular}
    </Text>
    <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
      {#each items as q, i (q.id)}
        {#if (i < 3)}
          <ListItem data-testid="faq-popular">
            <MenuEntry href={q.href} class="text-sm font-medium" size="sm">
              {q.question}
            </MenuEntry>
          </ListItem>
        {/if}
      {/each}
